vb_textbox.text: Pick a big hat or a little hat, and stick with that while it is 5+ mushrooms. When it drops, switch to the other hat until you get back to 5+, then stick with that one again. The hats switch sides each time so the same hat is s-k-s-k-s-k-s-k etc. That should get you over 1000+ in the timeframe. Don't be tempted to stray from this technique, persevere.
